race_courses.name: Malvern Hill, 5 km
race_courses.start_note: Start and finish on the White trail between the Carters Mill Road crossing and the Blue (Carter's Farm) trail junction west of The Parsonage. One lap clockwise: the White trail east past The Parsonage and south to the main lot, then north to the Confederate artillery and round the Blue trail.

route_guide.getting_there: Park at the lot opposite The Parsonage on Willis Church Road and join the White trail. The start line is on the White trail just west of where the Blue (Carter's Farm) trail branches off, not far west of The Parsonage.

race_courses.name: Malvern Hill, 10 km (2 laps)
race_courses.start_note: Start and finish on the White trail just west of the Blue (Carter's Farm) trail junction west of The Parsonage. The lead-in runs south-west on the White trail across Carters Mill Road to the Confederate artillery; each lap goes clockwise round the Blue trail, the White trail east past The Parsonage, south to the main lot and north again.

route_guide.getting_there: Park at the lot opposite The Parsonage on Willis Church Road and join the White trail. The start line is on the White trail just west of where the Blue (Carter's Farm) trail branches off, not far west of The Parsonage.
